utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help spread the word once the repair drive date, time, and meeting spot are confirmed. Could you share those details when Jules has them?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can check who still needs repairs and help spread the word once we have it. Just send me the time and meeting spot when they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — I’ll wait for Jules to confirm the date, time, and meeting spot, then I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll sort the donated tools and keep any lend-out ones separated. I’ll also label the boxes at Leo’s place this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I can help this afternoon with whatever’s still left for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane — that would help a lot. I’ll have the tools sorted and labeled at Leo’s place this afternoon, and we can tackle whatever’s left together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word to the neighbors and keep repeating the plan. Dane can start with donations and then help load the truck, while Jules keeps connecting folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can Pia confirm the timing and pickup details for the repair drive? I just want to make sure we have that right.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can repeat the plan to the neighbors, but I don’t have Pia’s confirmation yet. Once she confirms the timing and pickup details, I’ll keep passing it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll send Hana the date, time, and meeting spot once I’ve confirmed them. Dane can help this afternoon, and I’ll make sure Vik gets the details to pass along once Nell has them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — Sunday at the community center still works for me, and I can work around the school schedule. I’ll let Opal and Leo know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Sunday at the community center works — I’ll share the confirmed details with Hana and keep the word moving. Thanks for letting Opal and Leo know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: As soon as we confirm the repair drive location, I’ll head straight over and send Pia the timing and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s at the community center on Sunday. I’ll bring a few supplies, and you can send Pia the timing and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ve got it — I’ll head straight over on Sunday and let Pia know the timing and pickup details now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — it’s on Saturday. I can help spread the word if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That would be great, Noah — the more folks who know, the better. I’ve already got Tess and Cleo on board, and Nell’s helping spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Nice, sounds like we’ve got a good little team going. If you need one more hand, I’m around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll put together a clear list of what’s left for the repair drive and send it to Ira. Then I’ll pass the rest to Dane so he can sort it out this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send me the time and place, and I’ll handle the rest. Dane can help load the truck, and Bo’s bringing gloves, a flashlight, and tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me — I’ll send you the time and place, and I’ll keep Dane on the leftover list for this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still happy to come by for the repair drive, and I’ll keep an ear out for any updates. If I hear anything new, I’ll let Eli know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — once Kira confirms the timing and pickup details and Faye confirms the location, I can help with the repair drive. Then we can make sure the supplies and plan are set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds great — once Kira and Faye confirm everything, I’ll keep listening for updates too. Oren already sorted the donated screws and checked the tape inventory, so we’re in decent shape.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ve got gloves, a flashlight, and a few basic tools. I’ll help inspect and fix things by the mailboxes first, then we can work down the list on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. Gus can lend a few more tools if we need them, and Rosa’s keeping the sign-up list straight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, that covers it. I’ll watch for Leo’s time and place, and we can start by the mailboxes on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s set for Saturday — I can send Noah the time and location if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks — Saturday works. I can check in with Mina about who still needs repairs and help with tools and hands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll send Noah the time and location, and we can keep Mina in the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m out running errands, so I’ll keep an ear out for anything that needs help and send folks to Gus if I hear of anyone. If you need the timing or pickup details, Pia has those.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’ll help spread the word and send people to Gus if they need tools. I’ll check in with Pia for the timing and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks, Nell — I’ll do the same while I’m out and pass along anyone who needs a hand. If Eli sends the list of what’s left, I’ll keep that in mind too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s on Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the sign-up list ready. If you’ve got a repair request, you can bring it by my porch or leave a note at the community board.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a few tools ready to lend for Sunday, Rosa. Just let me know what folks need, and I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Gus—thank you. I’ll keep track of what’s needed and let you know which tools would help most on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — Sunday at the community center still works, and I’ve got the sign-up list ready. If anything shifts, let me know and I’ll update the repair drive notes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me, and I can help keep it lined up with the school schedule. I’ll let Leo and Opal know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Faye — that’s a big help. I’ll keep the list updated, and if anyone has repair requests, they can bring them by my porch or leave a note at the community board.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll bring gloves, a flashlight, and a few basic tools. I’ll start by the mailboxes and work down the list, and Leo can send the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll join as soon as I can and help wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, see you Saturday then — we’ll start by the mailboxes and go down the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday works for the repair drive. I can check in with Mina about who still still needs repairs, and I can bring tools and a steady pair of hands too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Rey. I’ll sort the screws and check the tape inventory, and I’ll let Faye know the time right away since she can work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I’ll talk to Mina and help with tools on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a few tools ready to lend for the repair drive. Once Uli’s list is set, we’ll know exactly where to start.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll get the list set and send it over so we can start with the biggest fixes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, that’ll help a lot. Once you send it over, I’ll line up the tools for the biggest fixes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Once we have the timing, pickup details, and the supplies sorted, I can help with the repair drive. Kira still needs confirmation on the timing and pickup, and Faye needs to confirm the location first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ve got the timing and pickup details lined up, and the supplies are sorted. Once I confirm the location, I’ll pass everything along to Jules so Hana and the others can be updated.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that covers my part. Once Faye confirms the location, send me the details and I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll sort the rest and send the time and place soon. Bo’s got the gloves, flashlight, and basic tools, and Dane can help load the truck.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — just send the place as soon as it’s confirmed, and I’ll head straight over and loop Pia in on the timing and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the place as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll spread the word once the time’s set. And I heard Tess is planning to come by too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Tess will be a big help. I’ll keep sharing the word, and we’ll make sure Cleo’s on the list too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll keep passing it along, and it’s nice to know Tess is coming by once the time’s set.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m bringing a few supplies for the repair drive on Sunday at the community center. Thanks for checking in about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and pass folks along to Gus if anyone needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can check who still needs repairs and help spread the word. I’ll keep an eye out for Leo’s time and place and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mina — that’d be a huge help. I’ll send Hana the date, time, and meeting spot as soon as they’re confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, send it over when it’s set, and I’ll pass Leo’s time and place along too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll send Noah the time and location for Saturday’s repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll wait for the confirmed repair drive details before I help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send Noah the confirmed time and location for Saturday’s repair drive, then you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, Saturday — I always miss when these things get set. If you tell me the time and meeting spot, I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have the time or meeting spot yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear anything. I’m still planning to attend, so once I get the details I can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep an ear out too, since Saturday’s the day. Once you hear the time and meeting spot, send them my way and I’ll help spread the word.
